# 3. XGBoost (Gradient Boosted Machines)

```{r}

set.seed(1)

# Modified function that trains final model after CV
fit_xgboost_model <- function(species_name, pheno_var, climate_predictors, data) {
  
  # Prepare data
  xgb_data <- data %>%
    filter(species_common == species_name, year < 2025) %>%
    select(all_of(c(pheno_var, "UID", climate_predictors))) %>%
    na.omit()
  
  if (nrow(xgb_data) < 20) return(NULL)
  
  # Add tree-level features to capture hierarchy
  xgb_data <- xgb_data %>%
    group_by(UID) %>%
    mutate(
      tree_mean_pheno = mean(.data[[pheno_var]], na.rm = TRUE),
      tree_sd_pheno = sd(.data[[pheno_var]], na.rm = TRUE),
      tree_n_obs = n()
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(UID_numeric = as.numeric(as.factor(UID)))
  
  # Create feature matrix
  feature_cols <- climate_predictors
  X <- as.matrix(xgb_data %>% select(all_of(feature_cols)))
  y <- xgb_data[[pheno_var]]
  
  # 10-fold CV for evaluation
  set.seed(123)
  folds <- createFolds(1:nrow(xgb_data), k = 10, returnTrain = FALSE)
  predictions <- numeric(nrow(xgb_data))
  actuals <- y
  
  for(fold_idx in 1:length(folds)) {
    test_idx <- folds[[fold_idx]]
    train_idx <- setdiff(1:nrow(xgb_data), test_idx)
    
    dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X[train_idx, ], label = y[train_idx])
    dtest <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X[test_idx, ], label = y[test_idx])
    
    xgb_model <- xgb.train(
      data = dtrain,
      nrounds = 500,
      objective = "reg:squarederror",
      max_depth = 4,
      eta = 0.01,
      subsample = 0.7,
      colsample_bytree = 0.7,
      verbose = 0
    )
    
    predictions[test_idx] <- predict(xgb_model, dtest)
  }
  
  # Calculate CV metrics
  errors <- actuals - predictions
  cv_r2 <- cor(actuals, predictions)^2
  cv_rmse <- sqrt(mean(errors^2))
  cv_mae <- mean(abs(errors))
  cv_mape <- mean(abs(errors / actuals)) * 100 
  
  cat("\n  Training final model on all data...")
  dtrain_all <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X, label = y)
  
  final_model <- xgb.train(
    data = dtrain_all,
    nrounds = 500,
    objective = "reg:squarederror",
    max_depth = 4,
    eta = 0.01,
    subsample = 0.7,
    colsample_bytree = 0.7,
    verbose = 0
  )
  
  # Get feature importance from final model
  importance <- xgb.importance(model = final_model)
  
  # Store UID mapping for prediction
  uid_mapping <- data.frame(
    UID = xgb_data$UID,
    UID_numeric = xgb_data$UID_numeric
  ) %>% distinct()
  
  # Store tree-level stats for prediction
  tree_stats <- xgb_data %>%
    group_by(UID) %>%
    summarise(
      tree_mean_pheno = mean(.data[[pheno_var]], na.rm = TRUE),
      tree_sd_pheno = sd(.data[[pheno_var]], na.rm = TRUE),
      tree_n_obs = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  return(list(
    # Model objects
    model = final_model,
    
    # Model metadata
    species = species_name,
    phenology = pheno_var,
    climate_predictors = climate_predictors,
    feature_cols = feature_cols,
    
    # Training data info
    n_obs = nrow(xgb_data),
    uid_mapping = uid_mapping,
    tree_stats = tree_stats,
    
    # CV performance metrics
    cv_r2 = cv_r2,
    cv_rmse = cv_rmse,
    cv_mae = cv_mae,
    cv_mape = cv_mape,
    
    # CV predictions for diagnostics
    cv_predictions = predictions,
    cv_actuals = actuals,
    cv_errors = errors,
    
    # Feature importance
    importance = importance
  ))
}

# Run for all models
xgb_results <- list()

for (i in pheno_vars) {
  for (j in species_list) {
    cat("\nFitting XGBoost:", i, "for", j, "...")
    
    result <- tryCatch({
      fit_xgboost_model(j, i, climate_vars[[i]], tree_ldc_metrics_climate)
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat(" ERROR:", e$message)
      return(NULL)
    })
    
    if (!is.null(result)) {
      xgb_results[[paste(j, i, sep = "_")]] <- result
      cat(" CV R²:", round(result$cv_r2, 3))
    }
  }
}

# Save all models
cat("\n\nSaving models...\n")
saveRDS(xgb_results, "xgb_models_full.rds")
cat("Models saved to: xgb_models_full.rds\n")

# Extract results table
xgb_table <- map_df(xgb_results, function(x) {
  data.frame(
    species = x$species,
    phenology = x$phenology,
    n_obs = x$n_obs,
    RMSE = x$cv_rmse,
    MAE = x$cv_mae,
    MAPE = x$cv_mape,
    R2 = x$cv_r2
  )
})

# Save feature importance for all models
importance_all <- map_df(names(xgb_results), function(model_name) {
  x <- xgb_results[[model_name]]
  x$importance %>%
    mutate(
      species = x$species,
      phenology = x$phenology
    )
})
```

#5. Predicting Climate Senarios

```{r}

xgb_models <- readRDS("xgb_models_full.rds")

cat("Loaded", length(xgb_models), "models\n")

predict_climate_scenario <- function(models_list, scenario_data, scenario_name = "Scenario") {
  
  results <- map_df(names(models_list), function(model_name) {
    
    model_obj <- models_list[[model_name]]
    
    cat("\nPredicting:", model_obj$species, "-", model_obj$phenology)
    
    # Filter data for this species
    species_data <- scenario_data %>%
      filter(species_common == model_obj$species)
    
    if (nrow(species_data) == 0) {
      cat(" - No data for this species")
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    # Check if all required features exist (ONLY climate)
    missing_features <- setdiff(model_obj$feature_cols, names(species_data))
    if (length(missing_features) > 0) {
      cat(" - Missing features:", paste(missing_features, collapse = ", "))
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    # Create feature matrix - climate variables ONLY
    X_new <- as.matrix(species_data %>% select(all_of(model_obj$feature_cols)))
    
    # Predict
    predictions <- predict(model_obj$model, X_new)
    
    # Return results
    data.frame(
      scenario = scenario_name,
      UID = species_data$UID,
      species = model_obj$species,
      phenology = model_obj$phenology,
      predicted_doy = predictions
    )
  })
  
  return(results)
}


xgb_models <- readRDS("xgb_models_full.rds")

# Get current climate averages
current_climate <- read_csv("../../../data_raw/nooa_daily_weather_obs/climate_variables/climate_baseline.csv")

prcp_vars <- c("late_winter_prcp", "spring_prcp", "late_summer_prcp", "fall_cumulative_prcp")

temp_vars <- c("late_winter_temp", "late_winter_mean_tmax", "late_spring_temp", 
               "late_spring_mean_tmax","early_fall_temp", "early_fall_mean_tmax",
               "fall_mean_tmax","late_fall_temp" )

landcover_vars <- c("impervious_90m", "irrigated_90m", "unirrigated_90m", "tree_canopy_90m", "water_90m")

# Scenario 1: Baseline (current average)
scenario_baseline <- expand_grid(
  UID = unique(tree_ldc_metrics_climate$UID),
  current_climate
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    tree_ldc_metrics_climate %>%
      select(UID, species_common, all_of(landcover_vars)) %>%
      distinct(),
    by = "UID") 

current_warm <- scenario_baseline %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(temp_vars), ~.x + 0.8),
         impervious_90m = mean(impervious_90m, na.rm = TRUE),
         irrigated_90m = mean(irrigated_90m, na.rm = TRUE),
         unirrigated_90m = mean(unirrigated_90m),
         water_90m = mean(water_90m),
         tree_canopy_90m = mean(tree_canopy_90m)
         )

# +2°C (modify ALL temperature variables)
scenario_warm <- scenario_baseline %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(temp_vars), ~.x + 1.8),
         impervious_90m = mean(impervious_90m, na.rm = TRUE),
         irrigated_90m = mean(irrigated_90m, na.rm = TRUE),
         unirrigated_90m = mean(unirrigated_90m),
         water_90m = mean(water_90m),
         tree_canopy_90m = mean(tree_canopy_90m)
         )

# +2°C + 10% more precipitation
scenario_warm_wet <- scenario_warm %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(prcp_vars), ~.x * 1.07))

# +2°C - 10% less precipitation
scenario_warm_dry <- scenario_warm %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(prcp_vars), ~.x * 0.93))

# ===== Predict all scenarios =====
cat("\n\n===== Predicting Climate Scenarios =====\n")

predictions_baseline <- predict_climate_scenario(xgb_models, scenario_baseline, "Baseline")
predictions_actual <- predict_climate_scenario(xgb_models, current_warm, "Actual Warming +0.8C")
predictions_warm <- predict_climate_scenario(xgb_models, scenario_warm, "+1.8C")
predictions_warm_wet <- predict_climate_scenario(xgb_models, scenario_warm_wet, "+1.8C +7% precip")
predictions_warm_dry <- predict_climate_scenario(xgb_models, scenario_warm_dry, "+1.8C -7% precip")

# Combine all scenarios
all_scenario_predictions <- bind_rows(
  predictions_baseline,
  predictions_actual,
  predictions_warm,
  predictions_warm_wet,
  predictions_warm_dry
)

all_scenario_predictions %>% 
  group_by(species, phenology, scenario) %>% 
  summarise(mean_doy = mean(predicted_doy, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_doy = sd(predicted_doy, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = scenario, 
              values_from = c(mean_doy, sd_doy)) %>%
  mutate(
   mean_diff_0.8C = `mean_doy_Actual Warming +0.8C` - mean_doy_Baseline,
    mean_diff_1.8C = `mean_doy_+1.8C` - mean_doy_Baseline,
    mean_diff_1.8C_dry = `mean_doy_+1.8C -7% precip`- mean_doy_Baseline,
   mean_diff_1.8C_wet = `mean_doy_+1.8C +7% precip` - mean_doy_Baseline,
 ) -> summary_table
  
p_values <- all_scenario_predictions %>%
  group_by(species, phenology) %>%
  summarise(
    p_value_0.8C = t.test(predicted_doy[scenario == "Actual Warming +0.8C"], 
                          predicted_doy[scenario == "Baseline"])$p.value,
    p_value_1.8C = t.test(predicted_doy[scenario == "+1.8C"], 
                          predicted_doy[scenario == "Baseline"])$p.value,
    p_value_1.8C_dry = t.test(predicted_doy[scenario == "+1.8C -7% precip"], 
                              predicted_doy[scenario == "Baseline"])$p.value,
    p_value_1.8C_wet = t.test(predicted_doy[scenario == "+1.8C +7% precip"], 
                              predicted_doy[scenario == "Baseline"])$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

summary_table %>%
  left_join(p_values, by = c("species", "phenology")) %>% 
  write_csv("../../../tables/summary_table_climate_senarios")
  
all_scenario_predictions %>% 
  mutate(
    phenology = factor(phenology, 
                      levels = c("Dormancy_doy", "Senescence_doy", "Maturity_doy", "Greenup_doy"),
                      labels = c("Dormancy", "Senescence", "Maturity", "Greenup"))  # Clean labels here!
   ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = species, y = predicted_doy, fill = scenario)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
  facet_wrap(~phenology, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y", strip.position = "right") +
  scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 6) +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "Day of Year",
    fill = "Scenario"
  ) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.key.size = unit(.5, "lines"),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "grey80"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    strip.text.y.right = element_text(angle = 90, face = "bold", size = 11),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = "grey80"),
    panel.spacing = unit(0.5, "lines")
  ) 
  ggsave("../../../images/climatechange_impact.png", width = 10, height = 10, dpi = 300)
```

#7. Partial Dependence Temp. and Prcp.

```{r}
get_partial_dependence <- function(species_name, phenology_stage, pred_var, 
                                   xgb_models, data, climate_vars) {
  
  # Get model
  model_key <- paste0(species_name, "_", phenology_stage)
  model_result <- xgb_models[[model_key]]
  model <- model_result$model
  
  # Prepare data - CLIMATE VARIABLES ONLY
  xgb_data <- data %>%
    filter(species_common == species_name) %>%
    select(all_of(c(phenology_stage, climate_vars[[phenology_stage]]))) %>%
    na.omit()
  
  feature_cols <- model_result$feature_cols  # Now just climate_predictors
  train_data <- as.data.frame(xgb_data %>% select(all_of(feature_cols)))
  
  # Create range for the variable to vary
  var_range <- seq(min(train_data[[pred_var]], na.rm = TRUE),
                   max(train_data[[pred_var]], na.rm = TRUE),
                   length.out = 100)
  
  # Create prediction grid
  pred_grid <- data.frame(matrix(ncol = length(feature_cols), nrow = length(var_range)))
  names(pred_grid) <- feature_cols
  
  # Set all variables
  for(col in feature_cols) {
    if(col == pred_var) {
      pred_grid[[col]] <- var_range  # Vary only this variable
    } else {
      pred_grid[[col]] <- mean(train_data[[col]], na.rm = TRUE)  # Mean for other climate vars
    }
  }
  
  # Make predictions
  predictions <- predict(model, as.matrix(pred_grid))
  
  pd_result <- data.frame(
    x = var_range,
    yhat = predictions,
    species = species_name,
    phenology = phenology_stage,
    variable = pred_var
  )
  
  names(pd_result)[1] <- pred_var
  return(pd_result)
}

```

#8. Ploting Individual Dependence Plot

```{r}

species_list <- c("American Elm", "American Linden", "Common Hackberry", 
                  "Eastern Cottonwood", "Green Ash", "Honey Locust",
                  "Northern Red Oak", "Plains Cottonwood", "Siberian Elm",
                  "Silver Maple", "Tree of heaven", "Western Catalpa")

# Loop through all species and create PD data
pd_all_species <- map_df(species_list, function(sp) {
  tryCatch({
    get_partial_dependence(
      species_name = sp,
      phenology_stage = "Senescence_doy",
      pred_var = "late_summer_mean_tmax",
      xgb_models = xgb_results,
      data = tree_ldc_metrics_climate,
      climate_vars = climate_vars
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("\nError for", sp, ":", e$message)
    return(NULL)
  })
})

# Plot all species together with both color and linetype
ggplot(pd_all_species, aes(x = late_summer_mean_tmax, y = yhat, 
                            color = species, linetype = species)) +
  geom_smooth(size = 1) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("solid", "dashed", "dotted", "dotdash", 
                                   "longdash", "twodash", "solid", "dashed", 
                                   "dotted", "dotdash", "longdash", "twodash")) +
  labs(
    x = "Late Summer Mean Tmax (°C)",
    y = "Predicted Senescence DOY",
    title = "Senescence Response to Temperature Across Species",
    color = "Species",
    linetype = "Species"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```

#9. Ploting All Individual Dependence Plot

```{r}

# Define climate variables and their corresponding phenology stages
climate_var_mapping <- data.frame(
  variable = c("late_winter_prcp", "late_winter_temp", 
                   "late_spring_prcp_days", 
                   "late_spring_temp",
                   "spring_prcp",
                   "late_summer_mean_tmax", "early_fall_mean_tmax", "late_summer_prcp",
                   "fall_prcp_days", "fall_mean_tmax"),
  phenology = c("Greenup_doy", "Greenup_doy", "Maturity_doy",
                "Maturity_doy", "Maturity_doy", 
                "Senescence_doy", "Senescence_doy", "Senescence_doy",
                "Dormancy_doy", "Dormancy_doy")
)

species_list <- c("American Elm", "American Linden", "Common Hackberry", 
                  "Eastern Cottonwood", "Green Ash", "Honey Locust",
                  "Northern Red Oak", "Plains Cottonwood", "Siberian Elm",
                  "Silver Maple", "Tree of heaven", "Western Catalpa")

# Loop through all combinations
pd_all_results <- map_df(1:nrow(climate_var_mapping), function(i) {
  
  var <- climate_var_mapping$variable[i]
  pheno <- climate_var_mapping$phenology[i]
  
  cat("\nProcessing", var, "for", pheno, "\n")
  
  # Loop through species
  map_df(species_list, function(sp) {
    tryCatch({
      pd <- get_partial_dependence(
        species_name = sp,
        phenology_stage = pheno,
        pred_var = var,
        xgb_models = xgb_results,
        data = tree_ldc_metrics_climate,
        climate_vars = climate_vars
      )
      
      # Rename first column to standardized name
      pd <- pd %>%
        rename(x_value = 1) %>%
        select(x_value, yhat, species, phenology, variable)
      
      return(pd)
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("  Error for", sp, ":", e$message, "\n")
      return(NULL)
    })
  })
})

# Create labels with units

  "late_winter_prcp" = "Late Winter Precip (mm)",

  "late_spring_prcp_days" = "Late Spring Precip Days",

  "early_fall_mean_tmax" = "Early Fall Tmax (°C)",
  "late_summer_prcp" = "Late Summer Precip (mm)",
  "fall_prcp_days" = "Fall Precip Days",
  "fall_mean_tmax" = "Fall Tmax (°C)",
  "fall_cumulative_prcp" = "Fall Cumulative Precip (mm)"
)

pd_all_results %>%
  mutate(
    pheno_label = case_when(
      phenology == "Greenup_doy" ~ "Green-up",
      phenology == "Maturity_doy" ~ "Maturity",
      phenology == "Senescence_doy" ~ "Senescence",
      phenology == "Dormancy_doy" ~ "Dormancy"
    ),
    # Identify variable type
    var_type = case_when(
      str_detect(variable, "prcp") ~ "Precipitation",
      str_detect(variable, "temp|tmax") ~ "Temperature"

    var_label = paste0(var_labels[variable], "\n(", pheno_label, ")"),

    pheno_order = factor(phenology,

  ) %>%
  arrange(pheno_order, var_type, variable) %>%
  mutate(var_label = factor(var_label, levels = unique(var_label))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = x_value, y = yhat, color = species, linetype = species)) +
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE, size = 1) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("solid", "dashed", "dotted", "dotdash", 
                                   "longdash", "twodash", "solid", "dashed", 
                                   "dotted", "dotdash", "longdash", "twodash")) +
  facet_wrap(~var_label, scales = "free", nrow = 6, ncol = 2) +
  labs(
    x = NULL, 
    y = "Predicted Phenological Timing (DOY)",
    color = "Species",
    linetype = "Species"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.5, "cm"),
    legend.key = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9)
  )

ggsave("../../../images/partial_depences_climnate_responces.png",

```

#10. Partial Dependence Plots - Land Cover Variables

```{r}

# Define land cover variables (just impervious and irrigated)
land_cover_vars <- c("impervious_90m", "irrigated_90m")

# Create mapping for land cover across all stages
climate_var_mapping <- expand.grid(
  variable = land_cover_vars,
  phenology = c("Greenup_doy", "Maturity_doy", "Senescence_doy", "Dormancy_doy"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

species_list <- c("American Elm", "American Linden", "Common Hackberry", 
                  "Eastern Cottonwood", "Green Ash", "Honey Locust",
                  "Northern Red Oak", "Plains Cottonwood", "Siberian Elm",
                  "Silver Maple", "Tree of heaven", "Western Catalpa")

# Loop through all combinations
pd_land_cover <- map_df(1:nrow(climate_var_mapping), function(i) {
  
  var <- climate_var_mapping$variable[i]
  pheno <- climate_var_mapping$phenology[i]
  
  cat("\nProcessing", var, "for", pheno, "\n")
  
  # Loop through species
  map_df(species_list, function(sp) {
    tryCatch({
      pd <- get_partial_dependence(
        species_name = sp,
        phenology_stage = pheno,
        pred_var = var,
        xgb_models = xgb_results,
        data = tree_ldc_metrics_climate,
        climate_vars = climate_vars
      )
      
      # Rename first column to standardized name
      pd <- pd %>%
        rename(x_value = 1) %>%
        select(x_value, yhat, species, phenology, variable)
      
      return(pd)
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("  Error for", sp, ":", e$message, "\n")
      return(NULL)
    })
  })
})

# Create labels
var_labels <- c(
  "impervious_90m" = "Impervious Surface (%)",
  "irrigated_90m" = "Irrigated Land (%)"
)

```

```{r}

# Plot land cover effects with ONE overall trend line
pd_land_cover %>%
  mutate(
    pheno_label = case_when(
      phenology == "Greenup_doy" ~ "Green-up",
      phenology == "Maturity_doy" ~ "Maturity",
      phenology == "Senescence_doy" ~ "Senescence",
      phenology == "Dormancy_doy" ~ "Dormancy"
    ),
    pheno_order = factor(phenology, 
                        levels = c("Greenup_doy", "Maturity_doy", 
                                   "Senescence_doy", "Dormancy_doy")),
    var_label = var_labels[variable]
  ) %>%
  arrange(pheno_order, variable) %>%
  mutate(
    pheno_label = factor(pheno_label, levels = unique(pheno_label)),
    var_label = factor(var_label, levels = var_labels)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = x_value, y = yhat)) +
  # Individual species lines
  geom_smooth(aes(color = species, linetype = species), se = FALSE, size = 0.8, alpha = 0.5) +
  # ONE overall linear trend line (dashed, black)
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("solid", "dashed", "dotted", "dotdash", 
                                   "longdash", "twodash", "solid", "dashed", 
                                   "dotted", "dotdash", "longdash", "twodash"))+
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black", 
              size = 1.2, linetype = "dashed") +
  #scale_color_brewer(palette = "Paired") +
  facet_grid(pheno_label ~ var_label, scales = "free") +
  labs(
    x = "Land Cover (%)",
    y = "Predicted Phenological Timing (DOY)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),
    legend.key = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10)
  ) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 3, ncol = 4, byrow = TRUE))

ggsave("../../../images/pd_land_cover_impervious_irrigated.png", 
       width = 10, height = 10, dpi = 300)

```
